full_judgment: 31. In Abdul Hakim alias Lokman Hakim vs State, 41 DLR (AD) 126 the victim Nawab Ali before death made dying declaration which was recorded by a Magistrate, First Class. There had been no eye-witness of the occurrence but there had been evidence adduced by PW 1 who rushed to the victim immediately after the occurrence. It has been held that the evidence of PW 1 who rushed to the victim immediately after the occurrence is trustworthy and there is no good reason to doubt the appellant's complicity in the commission of offence alleged.
